wipeComputer.title: Save Required Information
wipeComputer.saveRequiredContent: To protect business information, your hard drive needs to be securely erased prior to shipment. A self-help utility <1>DATA TRANSFER GUIDE</1> is available to assist you with removing any required files off the hard drive before erasing it.

eraseContent.title: Erase Hard Drive Instructions
eraseContent.eraseDriveContentBodyOne: Next, you will install a software package that will securely erase data from your hard drive. After the software conducts a successful pre-check on opening, you will begin the process, which could take an hour or more. Please refer to <1>this article</1> for step by step instructions on the data wiping process.
eraseContent.eraseDriveContentBodyTwo: This process, once initiated from within the software package, cannot be reversed and your files cannot be recovered. Only click <1>Initiate Process</1> after opening the downloaded software package while on the computer listed above that needs to be erased. When the process is complete, your device will be ready for shipment.
